subject: Kestrel Systems — Sponsor handoff & CIO attendance for demo
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Dec 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Kestrel Systems — Sponsor handoff & CIO attendance for demo

Evelyn / Priyom,

Quick heads-up: Kestrel (Liam/Marta) just asked for a demo next week and specifically requested CIO presence for the final 20–30 minutes to sign off on security and SSO flow. They gave two windows: Dec 12 morning or Dec 13 late afternoon (PST). Marta also flagged procurement will need an initial MSA and a short SSO/SCIM integration doc to review ahead of time — I attached the latest agenda (v2) that highlights the sections they asked about.

Ask: can you confirm whether we should try to secure an exec (VP/Head of Product or CTO) for the session, or handle as a sponsor handoff where Ben leads and Evelyn brings the exec for the last 20? If we can’t lock CIO, we should still aim for the VP to be on the call.

I propose: Priyom own procurement/terms pre-brief, Ben run demo, Evelyn do sponsor handoff + brief exec remarks. If all agree I’ll reply with the two options and propose a meeting time.

Attachments: redwood-demo-agenda-v2.pdf

Thanks,
Ben
Sales Director | Redwood Inference
From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@kestrel-sys.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@kestrel-sys.com>, procurement@kestrel-sys.com
Date: Tue, 5 Dec 2028 10:03:12 -0800
Subject: Re: Kestrel Systems — Sponsor handoff & CIO attendance for demo

Ben, Evelyn — thanks for the quick reply and for the agenda. Confirming a couple of points from our side:

- We do want our CIO (Tom Avery) to join the final portion to validate the SSO/enterprise security approach; it’s important for budget sign-off.
- Preferred windows: Dec 12 09:00–10:00 PST OR Dec 13 16:00–17:00 PST. We lean to the 13th (late afternoon) if that helps internal schedules.
- Procurement would like to see a clean MSA template (or redline guidance) and a short SSO integration note (SCIM, session timeout, data residency) before the demo. Can you share the SSO doc you mentioned?

I’ve CC’d procurement to loop them in. If you can confirm who from Redwood will provide the overview for the exec portion, we’ll lock the time and circulate a calendar invite.

Best,
Marta Ruiz
Head of IT Programs | Kestrel Systems
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@kestrel-sys.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Dec 2028 11:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kestrel Systems — Sponsor handoff & CIO attendance for demo

Thanks Marta — appreciated.

Quick plan from our side: Ben will lead the demo and cover product flow; I will join as the executive sponsor and do the closing 20 minutes to speak to reliability/SLA commitments and the roadmap alignment your CIO will want to hear. Priyom — can you prepare a short procurement packet (MSA highlights + core commercial bullets) and drop it in the thread by EOD? I’ll make a targeted ask to our Head of Product to be on standby in case a deeper architecture question comes up, but I can’t promise the CTO for the proposed windows.

We prefer Dec 13 16:00–17:00 PST as well — less friction for our execs. I’ve attached an SSO overview (the one we send to prospects). It’s a one-pager with SCIM / SAML notes and token lifetime defaults. Ben, I’ll let you send the calendar invite once procurement confirms availability.

—Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
VP, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
Attachments: sso-integration-overview.docx
